name: Pass 31 outsourcing engagement governance
goal: Make client checkpoints, token budgets, iterations, and change approvals first-class DFMS controls.
risks: Agent swarm could spend material tokens without client approval
Scope could drift without change-control impact analysis
Iterations could proceed without client checkpoints or acceptance gates

nodes.label: Engagement governance critic review

node_contract.what: Review whether DFMS captures the outsourcing-style client/vendor control loop.
node_contract.why: The human owner wants a dark factory that replaces outsourcing while improving confidence, checkpoints, and budget transparency.
node_contract.how: Inspect meta, orchestration, governance, handoff, feedback, design, and validation surfaces.
node_contract.where: Installed skills, workspace skills, design docs, and validation runner.
node_contract.who: Codex using system, governance, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Every gap becomes executable validation or explicit residual risk.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any unapproved scope, budget, or iteration path becomes validator logic and a runner fixture.

nodes.label: Engagement governance implementation

node_contract.what: Add engagement governance records and validation.
node_contract.why: Material work needs approved client checkpoints, rough token budget, iteration plan, and change-control policy.
node_contract.how: Add template, validator, fixture, skill instruction updates, design updates, manifest entries, and hardening checks.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before verification closure.
node_contract.how_good: Complete engagement fixture passes; template, unapproved budget, and incomplete change-control fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every governance validator change.
gates: engagement fixtures pass and reject as expected

nodes.label: Pass 31 verification sweep

node_contract.why: Engagement-governance hardening only counts if the full suite and merged records pass.
node_contract.how: Run hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 31 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
